purpose: Determine the strongest prospectively admissible v9 validation design from source-native structure before calculating any network outcome.

primary_source_files.reason: Use the all-interactions source representation for reconstruction. Files prefixed ints_S_1CV are source-side filtered derivatives and cannot replace the all-interactions source before targets.

pre_target_questions: Do the spatial and temporal matrices use the same stable PO..._PL... pair identity universe?
Are the 42 B/S columns and three tYYYY columns non-negative integer count matrices?
Does any deposited source expose pair records jointly indexed by both spatial network and year, rather than separate spatial and temporal marginals?
Does any deposited source expose plant/resource availability independently of realized pollinator interactions at a network/site scale?
Does any deposited source expose observation/sampling effort or exposure at a network/site scale?
Can the 42 spatial network identifiers be treated as the only source-native repeated spatial validation units without inventing missing site-year structure?

claim_ladder.full_v9: Allowed only if independent local plant/resource opportunity and auditable repeated network units are source-visible, with heterogeneous sampling exposure either absent, standardized, or separately observable before targets.
claim_ladder.pair_support_only: Use only the 42 spatial pair-count networks if raw pair counts and repeated spatial IDs are source-visible but independent plant/resource opportunity is not. This can test the inherited v8 pair-support layer or a reduced v9 prediction, not the v9 plant-opportunity mechanism.
claim_ladder.blocked: Stop before targets if pair identity/count semantics, repeated spatial units, or observation provenance cannot be audited from the author deposit.

hard_boundaries: 42 spatial columns and three annual columns are separate marginals unless a source-native site-year key is demonstrated.
Never construct a 42 x 3 site-year grid from the separate marginals.
Never infer plant availability from visited plants if the source does not independently record available/flowering plants.
Never use rare-interaction-filtered source derivatives to improve agreement with v9.
No pair-support fraction, turnover, Shannon diversity, support richness, empirical range, or v9 predictive envelope may be calculated in this gate.
Menorca, Giannutri and Cabrera remain consumed failures and are not validation inputs.
